name: PT Citra Borneo Utama Tbk
summary: PT Citra Borneo Utama Tbk engages in palm oil refining, and trading activities in Indonesia and internationally. The company offers product and services, such as refined bleached deodorized palm oil, refined bleached deodorized palm olein, refined bleached deodorized palm stearin, palm fatty acid distillate, crude palm kernel oil, and palm kernel expeller. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Pangkalan Bun, Indonesia. PT Citra Borneo Utama Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Citra Borneo Indah.
